## 终端工作区化、Skills 提问预算与知识质量契约

- 终端改为归属项目工作区而非单个对话：删除对话不再终止其中的进程，同项目各对话共享终端列表，跨对话引用终端输出保持有效。
- 移除 Workspace 图谱（索引构建、图谱页及 `/build-graph`、`/update-graph`）。跨仓查证统一使用 `/ask` 的并行调查与源码搜索。
- Engineering Skills 的 grilling 增加提问预算：需求明确时不提问，每轮优先 1–3 个高价值问题、默认不超过 5 个，低风险可逆决策由 Agent 按项目惯例自主处理，能形成可实施设计即停止。
- learn 增加知识质量契约：条目 status（verified / inferred / unverified）取最弱的实质性结论，混合证据在正文分级标注；合并更新保留历史有效来源并去重，知识冲突与版本冲突显式报告、不静默覆盖。
- 读取预览重排：tab-size 4 与关连字，放大／复制并入文件内容标签行；顶栏浏览器按钮全视图常驻；后台命令并入「运行了命令」命令行。

## Workspace-scoped terminals, skill question budget, and knowledge quality contract

- Terminals now belong to the project workspace instead of a single conversation: deleting a conversation no longer kills its processes, conversations in the same project share the terminal list, and terminal references stay valid across conversations.
- The Workspace graph (index building, the Graph page, and `/build-graph` / `/update-graph`) has been removed. Cross-repository investigation is unified under `/ask` with parallel investigations and source search.
- The grilling engineering skill now has a question budget: no questions when the requirement is already clear, 1–3 high-impact questions per round with a default maximum of 5, low-risk reversible decisions handled autonomously using project conventions, and interviews stop as soon as a sound, implementable design exists.
- learn gains a knowledge quality contract: an entry's status (verified / inferred / unverified) reflects its weakest material claim, mixed-evidence documents mark evidence levels in the body, merges preserve and deduplicate existing valid sources, and knowledge or version conflicts are reported explicitly instead of silently overwritten.
- Read preview rework: tab-size 4 with ligatures disabled, zoom/copy moved into the file content label row; the toolbar browser button is available in every view; background tasks merge into the "ran commands" row.
